title: AI Document Validation & Reading Mastery Analytics (v0.4.19)
message: Enforced AI validation to reject unrelated documents (Math, Science formulas), revamped teacher & admin metrics to modern Reading Mastery standards, and enabled full CSV and mobile roster exports.
changelog:
• AI Document Upload Validation: Automatically inspects teacher PDFs and strictly rejects non-reading documents (Math problem sets, Science formulas, lab logs, coding scripts), ensuring only reading comprehension materials and literature are accepted.
• Reading Mastery Analytics: Overhauled teacher mobile statistics and admin portal dashboards with modern reading fluency metrics.
• Universal Data Export: Added client-side CSV downloads in the web admin portal and Android Share Sheet exports for student rosters and support radar.
• Zero Jargon & Clean UI: Enforced modern literacy mastery benchmarks throughout.
